verdict.rationale: Rootly documents its own iOS and Android mobile app for on-call. The app provides an Incident Summary card, conversational Rootly AI on incidents, and mobile shift swaps and overrides. The evidence never explicitly says acknowledge, escalate, or resolve can be done in the mobile app; that wording appears only for Microsoft Teams, which does not transfer to this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of acknowledging, escalating and resolving pages from the mobile app, push-notification paging details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, a full mobile app lets me acknowledge, escalate, and resolve from my phone at 3am

citations.quote: Rootly mobile app for iOS and Android on-ca
On any incident you have access to, the mobile app gives you an Incident Summary card and the conversational Rootly AI agent.
Get an Incident Summary card and the Rootly AI chat on your phone while on-call
